works.title: Shrimp Love Bugs Me
works.description: How to be Human is a limited series about Juno (alien, from outer space), who visits Earth on a shadow government run scholarship and gets a taste of that typical college experience. In colaboration with Elle Creasy, “Shrimp Love Bugs Me” is an amalgamation of our passion for comedy, animation, and… lesbianism? Through experimental animation — puppetry, digital art, and mixed media collage — we create a silly, absurdist take on social media algorithms and polarizing online propaganda.
